title: 第21章 抵达太玄剑院第22章 修炼
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
想要抵达金澜城，路途还是很艰辛的。
不过因为有地魔兽，一路上也没有遇到什么危险。
镇地犀牛堪比道灵第六境的速度，足以甩掉大部分麻烦。
两日后的正午，众人便抵达了金澜城。
高达百米的巨大城墙矗立在大地上，给人一种难以跨越的感觉。
在这城墙之后，便是繁荣的金澜城！
城墙外，还有着不少聚集地。
这些聚集地里的居民更多的是逃难至此的流民，没有固定居所。
只有在金澜城外可以勉强得到庇护，不至于连一个落脚的地方都没有。
这个世界，处处充满了危险。
随便一只一阶奴仆魔兽，都能要了普通人的性命。
比起这些流离失所，逃难至此的流民来说，丘凌风这些村民的待遇要好上不少。
至少，村庄之中还有着学校，能够提供些许修行上的指导。
而流民聚集地，想要成为武者只能靠运气。
“这些人原本居住的地方，已经被魔兽摧毁了。”
万林海开口说道，
“大概是三个月前，南方多了一头将领级的兽王。”
“将领级！”
丘凌风听到这个词的时候，忍不住吸了一口气。
魔兽也是有强弱的。

最低等的魔兽为奴仆级，对应通脉境。
在这上面，有着精英级魔兽，对应人类的道灵境。
而在这之上，才是将领级，对应人族的魂相境！
道灵境对现在的丘凌风来说，就已经是遥不可及的存在了。
更别提堪比魂相境强者的将领级魔兽了！
“那……金澜城有没有派人剿杀那头将领级魔兽？”
丘凌风好奇的问道。
万林海却是摇了摇头，而后转移话题道：
“明年开春时，太玄剑院和南斗书院会在这些流民之中各选出十名弟子。
“这也算是金澜城对于这些流民的补偿吧。”
丘凌风点了点头。
看着城墙外的流民，不由握紧了拳头。
在这个世界上，人族的存在的确很渺小。
两头镇地犀牛来到城门处，吸引了不少流民的目光。
紧闭的城门，缓缓开了一道小缝，刚好可供两人通过。
从中走出几个全副武装的士兵，都是手中持着枪械。
正在全力戒备着周围的流民，以免他们趁机潜入金澜城中。
content_en:
The journey to reach Jinlan City is still very difficult.
However, because of the earthly monsters, there was no danger along the way.
The ground-suppressing rhinoceros is comparable to the speed of Daoling Sixth Realm, which is enough to get rid of most troubles.
At noon two days later, everyone arrived at Jinlan City.
A huge city wall with a height of 100 meters stands on the ground, giving people a feeling of being insurmountable.
Behind this city wall is the prosperous Jinlan City!
Outside the city wall, there are many gathering places.
The residents in these gathering areas are mostly refugees who have fled here and have no fixed residence.
Only outside Jinlan City can you barely get shelter, so that you don't even have a place to stay.
This world is full of dangers.
Any first-level slave monster can kill an ordinary person.
Compared with these displaced refugees who have fled here, the treatment of villagers like Qiu Lingfeng is much better.
At least, there is a school in the village that can provide some guidance on spiritual practice.
In a place where refugees gather, becoming a warrior can only rely on luck.
"The place where these people originally lived has been destroyed by monsters."
Wan Linhai said,
"About three months ago, there was a general-level beast king in the south."
"General level!"
When Qiu Lingfeng heard this word, he couldn't help but take a breath.
Warcraft also has strengths and weaknesses.
The lowest level of monsters is the slave level, which corresponds to the Tongmai realm.
On top of this, there are elite-level monsters, corresponding to the human Taoist realm.
And above this is the general level, which corresponds to the soul state of the human race!
The Dao Spirit Realm is already out of reach for Qiu Lingfeng now.
Not to mention the general-level monsters that are comparable to those in the Soul Realm!
"Then... did Jinlan City send anyone to kill that general-level monster?"
Qiu Lingfeng asked curiously.
Wan Linhai shook his head, then changed the topic:
“At the beginning of next spring, Taixuan Sword Academy and Nandou Academy will each select ten disciples from these refugees.
“This can be regarded as Jinlan City’s compensation for these refugees. "
Qiu Lingfeng nodded.
Looking at the refugees outside the city wall, I couldn't help clenching my fists.
In this world, the existence of human race is indeed very small.
Two rhinoceroses came to the city gate and attracted the attention of many refugees.
The closed city gate slowly opened a small crack, just enough for two people to pass through.
Several heavily armed soldiers walked out, all holding firearms in their hands.
He was fully vigilant against the surrounding refugees to prevent them from taking the opportunity to sneak into Jinlan City.
